parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistFetcherTests.swift`. The two methods — `fetchPlaylistReturnsEmptyOnDecodingError` (line 84) and `fetchPlaylistReturnsEmptyOnCancellationError` (line 103) — are structurally similar (Jaccard 0.73) but intentionally test distinct error conditions (decoding failure vs. cancellation). Collapsing them into a single parameterised test helper could obscure the specific failure scenario each case is meant to document, which is a common and accepted pattern in test suites. Per decision rule 1, all records being test fixtures is sufficient grounds for no-action.
